configuration.retrieval: all chunks searched; per-job score = best chunk + 0.05 x sum(other chunks); no threshold

metric_definitions.hit@k: 1 if any grade-2 (relevant) job is in the top k, averaged over queries.
metric_definitions.precision@k: grade-2 jobs in the top k divided by k.
metric_definitions.relaxed_precision@k: grade-1 or grade-2 jobs in the top k divided by k.
metric_definitions.recall@k: grade-2 jobs in the top k divided by all grade-2 jobs for the query (bounded by k / label count).
metric_definitions.capped_recall@k: grade-2 jobs in the top k divided by min(label count, k).
metric_definitions.mrr@10: mean of 1 / rank of the first grade-2 job within the top 10 (0 if none).
metric_definitions.ndcg@k: graded nDCG with gains 3 (relevant) and 1 (acceptable); ideal ranking built from the labels.
metric_definitions.top1_domain_accuracy: top-ranked job's domain equals the query's expected domain.
metric_definitions.negative: above_weakest_positive_top1: an off-topic query's top score is at least the lowest top-1 score of any genuine labelled query, i.e. no single threshold could separate them.
